basic_info.description: 511 Waller Street is ideally located in the heart of San Francisco in the Lower Haight neighborhood. This 6 unit investment property is comprised of 1 studio unit and 5 1-bedrooms spanning over 3 levels. The units have high ceilings, pine wood floors, bay windows, nice period detailing and all of them have decorative fireplaces. The heating is through electric baseboard heaters and the units are separately metered for both gas and electricity. The building has a basement level where each unit has an assigned storage area and coin operated laundry for the tenant's convenience. There is also a small, shared patio. The soft story retrofit and foundation upgrades have been completed as of 2018.
